_comment: Golden fixture pinning how a register event title is read as a timeline extension, across both hand-synced implementations: scripts/generate/static_data/outputs/extensions.py (is_extension_event, parse_business_days, reason_detail; writes extensions.json) and frontend/src/utils/timelineExtensions.js (isExtensionTitle, extensionBusinessDays, extensionReason; shades extensions on the merger detail timeline). Exercised by scripts/tests/test_extension_titles.py and frontend/src/utils/__tests__/timelineExtensions.test.js. business_days and reason are only asserted for titles that are extensions. If you change a rule, update both implementations and these cases. Covers each wording the register has used so far, plus the edge cases the rules have to agree on (singular day, case, stray whitespace and full stops, no count, no reason, non-extension titles).
